hypothesis: A three-slice composition can retain the collision gain of full idx13 and additional PPMD context capacity while tight FXCM cells keep the native process under the decimal 10GB guard.
kill_condition: Retire on any roundtrip, determinism, or decimal-RSS failure, or if exact archive bytes fail to beat both matched single-slice controls at the same population.
promotion_condition: Pass exact 250k archive, roundtrip, deterministic re-encode, and decimal RSS guard against the matched full-idx13 and PPMD-only controls; then run exact 10M unchanged.
title: Tight-cell full-idx13 plus 24MiB PPMD composition
